text:
mike_w: Hey team — noticed a spike in structured-output rejects for action hooks over the past hour, customers getting routed to the degen path. Dashboard shows a big bump in "rejected_fncalls" and support tickets asking why costs jumped. Can we triage? :eyes:
infra-bot: ALERT: 75 structured_output_rejects for route=fn-action in 10m (cluster-a). sample_id=fnr-1768.
mike_w: Quick repro of adapter response that tripped validator:
```json
{"tool_result": [
  {"name": "open_file", "args": {"path": "/etc/passwd"}}
]
}
```
jin_dev: That's an array vs the expected object shape. Validator error: `type_mismatch: expected object got array` (validator v2). Are these always arrays or a noisy adapter?
sara_product: From UX side customers see "invoked fallback" and a generic error in the Console. They can't tell whether it was a schema parsing issue vs model failure. Suggestion: expose `reject_reason` and sample payload in Console (behind a toggle) + an opt-in "soft-coerce" that attempts a best-effort coercion instead of hard reject.
alex_billing: Important: what are we billing for here? If we route to a cheaper fallback variant, are we still billing original model tokens or the fallback cost? Support customers are reporting token spikes on the same timestamp as rejects.
jin_dev: Current billing attribution is on the final served model. But our metrics emit `rejected_fncalls` as a separate counter and logs still contain the original request token counts in some traces (confusing). We only persist full reject payloads at 1% sampling.
ksenia_sre: Can we increase sampling for the affected customer/route to 5-10% temporarily? Need full payloads to debug whether this is adapter-wide or just a few connectors. Also we should throttle the telemetry retention to avoid PII logging.
mike_w: +1 to increased sampling for the tenant. Also we should add a short snip in the Console explaining that rejects may cause fallbacks and which model was billed.
sara_product: UX mocks: add a badge next to each invoke: `Reject: schema/type_mismatch` (click to expand sample). Also console toggle: `Log structured rejects (only sample)` and `Allow soft fallback`. Will draft copy.
alex_billing: For billing clarity proposal: if a reject triggers an automatic fallback we should emit `billing_hint: fallback_model_id` in the trace before charge. That way billing pipeline can de-duplicate/cherry-pick the right tokens. Thoughts?
jin_dev: Technically feasible — emitter change + small schema bump for invocation events. Need to coordinate with billing to avoid replay hazards. Also propose adding `reject_class` string (e.g., `validator:type_mismatch`, `parser:malformed_json`, `adapter:unexpected_shape`) to telemetry to make dashboards filterable.
ksenia_sre: Rollout plan: feature-flag the console toggles + `reject_class` telemetry. Canary to 3 internal teams, 24h monitoring window, then 50% tenant ramp. Add alert if reject_rate delta > 3x baseline.
mike_w: One more: need to avoid increasing customer-visible noise. If we add the Console badge, default should be off for existing customers; opt-in per route/tenant.
alex_billing: I'll confirm with billing infra on emitting `billing_hint`. If accepted, we can update the billing pipeline to prefer `billing_hint` when present.
jin_dev: Action items -> 1) I'll prototype the `reject_class` telemetry + `billing_hint` field (PR for event schema). 2) sara to provide Console copy + mock for the toggle. 3) ksenia to flip sampling for the affected tenant to 5% and watch retention. 4) alex to evaluate billing pipeline impact.
sara_product: I'll post mocks by EOD. Can we also add a brief blurb in support playbook explaining how to read the reject badge?
ksenia_sre: Will handle sampling and the alerting thresholds. Setting sampling for tenant=tier-enterprise, route=fn-action -> 5% now.
mike_w: Thanks. Let's sync tomorrow after first 12h of higher sampling. :thumbsup:
